No front door

Followers stay followers

A woman can save your posts for a year and never join an email list. Every day without a class capturing emails is attention you earned and don't get to keep.

No qualifier

Calls start from zero

Someone can go from one reel to a call with no idea how you work or what a labs review involves. A class lets her see your approach first, so the women who book already trust it.

Content treadmill

2,464 posts and counting

Growth still leans on the next post. When you take a week off, the enquiries take a week off too.

The women who love your content but aren't ready for 1:1 today have no clear next step, so most of them take none.

A $17 masterclass that pays for its own ads and fills your 1:1 calendar

Fixes the missing front door

One class becomes the link in your bio and the destination for your ads. Every buyer is an email you own, and every woman sees how you think before you ask for anything bigger.

Fixes the missing qualifier

A paid seat means people show up. The replay page invites women who want hands-on support to apply, so you only talk to people who watched, stayed and told you what's going on.

Pays for the ads

$17 seats and the [$37] Lab Prep Kit bring revenue in on the front end, so the cost of reaching new women is largely covered before anyone books a call.

The 95%*

Not ready for 1:1 yet

They buy a $17 seat, many add the Lab Prep Kit, and keep learning from your emails and content. They pay you while they build trust.

The qualified 5%

Ready for hands-on support

They watch to the end and apply on the replay page. The application filters for fit before your calendar, and three pre-call emails warm them up for 1:1.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

Script 1 · Reel · 30 to 45 seconds

"Normal is a range, not an answer"

Hook
"So many women hear 'your labs are normal' and still walk out with questions. Here's what I look at." (to camera, pink blazer, the same look as your profile)
Body
"Standard lab ranges are built to flag disease. A functional, root-cause approach also asks where you sit inside that range, and how your markers relate to each other and to how you feel. That's a different conversation." (simple on-screen captions)
CTA
"I teach how I read labs in a 90-minute class called Read Between the Labs. It's $17. Tap Sign up to save your seat. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 2 · Reel · 30 seconds

"Three questions for your next appointment"

Hook
"Three questions I'd bring to any lab appointment." (Sheeva holds up three fingers)
Body
"One: can I have a copy of my full results? Two: where do I sit within the range, not just inside or outside it? Three: what would you want to recheck, and when? Simple questions, much better conversations." (caption for each question)
CTA
"I go much deeper in my $17 masterclass. Link below. Educational content, not medical advice."
Script 3 · Reel · 45 seconds

"Where to start with my work"

Hook
"Women ask me where to start if they want to work with me. Here's my honest answer." (walking, natural light)
Body
"Start with my class. In 90 minutes you'll learn how I think about labs and brain health, you'll know which questions to ask, and you'll know whether 1:1 coaching is the right next step for you."
CTA
"It's called Read Between the Labs, it's $17, and there's a replay if you can't make it live. Tap Sign up."
